onboarding.first_question.reply_job: New beginnings bring excitement and uncertainty together. Looking at your chart, we can talk about which sides of this period bring you forward and where you might want to be careful.
onboarding.first_question.reply_relation: Indecision is often a tug of war between two real needs, like closeness and freedom. We can start naming those needs by looking at the relationship themes in your chart.
onboarding.first_question.reply_move: Leaving a place carries both curiosity and longing. Looking at your chart and the current sky, we can think together about what you want to pay attention to in this transition.
onboarding.first_question.reply_decision: With big decisions, it helps to see what is really holding you back before rushing. Looking at the tendencies in your chart, we can talk about how you work through decisions.
onboarding.first_question.reply_goal: Wanting to build your own path often asks for a balance of courage and structure. We can look at these themes in your chart and talk about your strengths and what to watch for.
onboarding.first_question.reply_generic: Good question. In a real chat I would look at your chart and today's sky to answer you personally. On this screen I'm only showing you how it looks.

onboarding.first_result.what_moon: Your Moon shows your emotions and what makes you feel safe.

onboarding.first_result.final_angles: What really matters are the angles. Let's discover them now.

onboarding.chat.c0.intro: A few questions I put together to get to know you.
onboarding.chat.c1.q: What would you like to look at first?
onboarding.chat.c1.reply.self: Let's begin with you; your chart works as a good mirror. I'll be with you along the way.
onboarding.chat.c1.reply.intentions: Good, your intentions work like a compass. What you want will shape the questions ahead.
onboarding.chat.c1.reply.soulmate: Then let's open the path to the heart that fits you best; the sky will walk with you.
onboarding.chat.c1.reply.love: Understood. Love and closeness will be our focus, and we'll read your heart's language together.
onboarding.chat.c1.reply.horoscope: Let's start with your sign. Your chart is like your own sky, and we'll read it together.
onboarding.chat.c1.reply.learn: Glad to hear it; curiosity is the best guide. I'll keep everything simple and clear as we go.
onboarding.chat.c1.reply.other: No problem, we'll see together. We'll look step by step at what feels right for you.
onboarding.chat.c2.q: Which part of life matters most to you right now?
onboarding.chat.c2.reply.love: Love is at the center now; let's look at what it asks of you.
onboarding.chat.c2.reply.career: Good, work and direction. We'll open that a little more in the next question.
onboarding.chat.c2.reply.money: I'll stay beside you to ease and strengthen your energy around money; we'll move step by step.
onboarding.chat.c2.reply.family: Understood, family and home. That warmth will stay near us here too.
onboarding.chat.c2.reply.confidence: That matters. We'll look gently at how you see yourself.
onboarding.chat.c2.reply.decision: Then let's look at the choice in front of you; I'll be with you as it becomes clearer.
onboarding.chat.c3.q: When something goes wrong, what do you usually do?
onboarding.chat.c3.reply.act: You move quickly, and that makes timing important for you. I'll keep that in mind.
onboarding.chat.c3.reply.wait: Understood, you wait first. We'll move at a rhythm that does not rush.
onboarding.chat.c3.reply.consult: Other people's views serve you well; I'll keep that in mind.
onboarding.chat.c3.reply.withdraw: I see, you need some distance first. I'll leave you your own space.
onboarding.chat.c7.q: How would you like me to talk with you?
onboarding.chat.c7.reply.soft: Alright, I'll keep things warm and gentle; we won't rush.
onboarding.chat.c7.reply.direct: Alright, I'll keep things short and clear, with nothing extra.
onboarding.chat.c5.q: Which moments would you like to feel ready for?
onboarding.chat.c5.opt.regret: Before I say something I'd regret
onboarding.chat.c5.reply.hard_days.soft: I hear you. I'll be beside you on hard days, and I'm keeping that in mind.
onboarding.chat.c5.reply.hard_days.direc: Noted: hard days. I'll help you feel ready for them.
onboarding.chat.c5.reply.regret.soft: Understood. Words you might regret matter, and I'll stay gentle with you.
onboarding.chat.c5.reply.regret.direct: Noted: words you may regret. I'll walk beside you to pause before you speak.
onboarding.chat.c5.reply.right_time.soft: Good. We'll read the sky's rhythm together so you can feel the right time.
onboarding.chat.c5.reply.right_time.dire: Noted: the right time to act. We'll focus on timing.
onboarding.chat.c5.reply.all.soft: Then I'll hold all of it in mind, gently, and stay with you.
onboarding.chat.c5.reply.all.direct: Noted: all of it. I'll follow all three with the same clarity.
onboarding.chat.notif.prompt.soft: When these moments come, I'd like to leave you a short note. Alerts aren't ready yet; if you allow it now, I'll be with you when they arrive.
onboarding.chat.notif.prompt.direct: Alerts aren't ready yet. If you allow notifications now, you'll be set when they arrive.
onboarding.chat.notif.granted.soft: Thank you. I'll remind you gently when alerts arrive.
onboarding.chat.notif.granted.direct: Done, you're set. I'll let you know when they're ready.
onboarding.chat.notif.denied.soft: That's completely fine; nothing changes here.
onboarding.chat.review.prompt.soft: If this felt helpful, a rating would mean a lot to me. A system window may open.
onboarding.chat.review.prompt.direct: A rating would help. A system window may open.
onboarding.chat.review.thanks.soft: Thank you; that really means a lot.
onboarding.chat.review.skip.soft: No worries at all, let's continue together.
onboarding.chat.close.soft: We're done here; come back whenever you like. I'll be here.
onboarding.chat.close.direct: That's all for now. Come back anytime.
